- **Licence changes on an established project cause forks and backlash, and recent moves are back toward OSI licences.** HashiCorp moved to BSL in August 2023, OpenTofu forked within weeks, and IBM closed the HashiCorp acquisition on 27 February 2025. Redis went to SSPL/RSAL in March 2024, Valkey forked under the Linux Foundation, and Redis 8 added AGPLv3 on 1 May 2025. Elastic added AGPLv3 back in August 2024. **Lesson: pick the licence on day one and never relicense the core.**
5. **Week 4:** Publish the open signed-manifest spec and the Apache-2.0 / commercial licensing policy, with a written commitment never to relicense the core.
